docs: add SKILL.md for AI agents

Add a single AI-readable SKILL.md and point to it from the README,
so any AI tool can learn to use stock-api by reading one URL.

fix(mcp): honor protocol version negotiation on initialize

Reply with the revision the client asked for when supported, and fall
back to the latest supported one otherwise. Also answer ping, return
-32601 for unknown methods, and drop JSON-RPC batching.

Closes #19

chore(release): 2.7.4

## [2.7.4](https://github.com/zhangxiangliang/stock-api/compare/v2.7.3...v2.7.4) (2026-09-06)

### Bug Fixes

* **mcp:** honor protocol version negotiation on initialize ([07556d9](https://github.com/zhangxiangliang/stock-api/commit/07556d99a652769906beb1f144b907fd7df5a5d9)), closes [#19](https://github.com/zhangxiangliang/stock-api/issues/19)

fix: split quote/search status and detect eastmoney JSONP responses

Eastmoney's search endpoint returns an anti-bot JSONP response for some
overseas networks, which previously made the whole provider report as
down. Track quote and search separately so a broken search only degrades
that provider instead of marking it fully down, and surface a clear error
when the response is JSONP instead of a raw JSON.parse failure. Also note
the limitation in the README and point to stocks.auto as the fallback.
